subject: Next steps: technical deep-dive and security/procurement intro
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@finlytics.com>, Priya Desai <priya@finlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps

Hi Samir / Priya,

Great to speak earlier — quick recap and proposed next steps so we don’t lose momentum:  

• Key priorities you mentioned: latency-sensitive batch inference for reports, strict data residency for logs, SSO via your IdP, and a 3‑month pilot with a staged rollout.
• Success criteria we agreed on: sub-250ms 95p for the typical 512-token flow, and model determinism on archived inputs.

Suggested next step: a technical deep-dive where we demo a focused pilot and map the platform/integration checklist. I’m proposing two 60‑minute windows:
  - Thu, Nov 12 — 11:00–12:00 PT
  - Fri, Nov 13 — 09:00–10:00 PT

Can you confirm which works? If neither, send 2–3 times that do. For the deep-dive I’d like to loop in a couple of folks from our side: Marissa Cole to run the demo and show the pilot template, and Rishi Malhotra to cover SSO/KMS/ops questions.

I’ve attached a short agenda (FinLytics-demo-agenda.pdf) — it’s intentionally tight (15m product + 30m hands-on + 15m integration & next steps).

Also: do you have a security contact we should include now so we can prep SOC2 evidence and network details ahead of the deep-dive? If you prefer, we can do a separate 30‑minute security intake after the initial demo.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0119

[attachment: FinLytics-demo-agenda.pdf]

From: Samir Khan <samir.k@finlytics.com>

Cc: Priya Desai <priya@finlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps

Thanks Karthik — useful summary. Fri, Nov 13 09:00–10:00 PT works best for our team. Please lock that slot if it’s still open.

Also: please include our security lead, Anita Gomez (anita.gomez@corpsecurity.com), and loop in procurement if possible — Priya is cc’d. Anita will want a short intake before the demo so she can collect the SOC2 checklist and network/IP allowlist.

Quick asks for the deep-dive:
• Can you confirm whether the pilot will run on a dedicated instance (we prefer isolation) and if so what the onboarding timeline looks like?
• Any pre-demo artifacts we should review besides the agenda?

Samir

Director of Data Products, FinLytics
samir.k@finlytics.com | +1 (617) 555-2390

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@finlytics.com>, Priya Desai <priya@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Anita Gomez <anita.gomez@corpsecurity.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps

Perfect — I’ll reserve Fri, Nov 13 09:00–10:00 PT on our side and send a Calendar invite in a minute.

Marissa — can you run the 60m deep-dive? Suggested run-of-show below; feel free to amend:  
  1) 5m quick context and success criteria (Samir)
  2) 15m focused product demo (Marissa)
  3) 25m hands-on: run a pilot flow, show latency/cost breakouts, and validate SSO handshake (Marissa + Rishi)
  4) 10m security/procurement checklist and next steps (Stephanie + Anita)

Stephanie — I’m attaching the SOC2 evidence checklist (SOC2-evidence-list.xlsx) to help Anita and Priya prepare. Can you call out anything we should pre-share before the meeting (e.g., network ranges, minimal data subsets, export controls)?

Samir / Priya / Anita — items for prep:  
• Please confirm whether the pilot should be dedicated or multitenant for the first 30 days.
• If dedicated, share an approximate start date target (Nov/Dec).
• If Anita or Priya want a pre-demo security intake, we can schedule a 30‑minute slot Wed/Thu this week — propose times and we’ll accommodate.

Forwarding Samir’s note below for context.

On Mon, Nov 9, 2026 at 10:12 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Great to speak earlier — quick recap and proposed next steps so we don’t lose momentum:  ...

Thanks all — I’ll send the invite and the HubSpot deal link once the calendar is set.

— Karthik

From: Anita Gomez <anita.gomez@corpsecurity.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps

Thanks — appreciate the agenda and the SOC2 checklist. I’m available Fri, Nov 13 09:00–10:00 PT but our security team has a conflict right at 09:15 that day — would you be able to shift slightly? Two alternatives from our side:
  - Fri, Nov 13 — 10:30–11:30 PT
  - Mon, Nov 16 — 11:00–12:00 PT

On the evidence front, I’ll need:
• Access to your SOC2 Type II report (or a point of contact to request it)
• The last 90 days of incident logs (redacted where required)
• Network IP ranges and egress endpoints for allowlisting

Priya (procurement) — I’ve looped you so we can coordinate the contract timeline and any redlines. If procurement can share a preferred cadence (SOW + PO or platform subscription) that’ll speed the onboarding conversation.

Anita
